In the fourth frame, the camera pitches straight down at the turf roughly 0.5 to 1.5 metres below—bringing the ground within arm's reach—showing a patch of weeds at the center and the camera wearer's own shadow along the left edge while the horizon and ball are out of view. In the fifth frame, the camera tilts back up toward the sky as the wearer turns, leaving most of the field out of view below the frame except for distant trees, light poles, and a sliver of the field edge along the bottom-left and bottom-right corners.
